tagline.es: Naipes, sorbos y el temido cuarto rey.
tagline.en: Cards, sips and the dreaded fourth king.
tagline.pt: Cartas, goles e o temido quarto rei.

canonExceptions.why: A drinking game for one table on one phone: no room to invite to, and the night's sips are not something it shares, so nothing goes through compartir.js.
In La Bodega since D-420, not worked on: its end keeps its own Volver al menú link from before fin.js (D-343); the exits from fin.js come when it leaves La Bodega.
